explication: Vvveb is a multi-site CMS and ecommerce platform with a drag-and-drop page builder and REST/GraphQL headless interfaces. A typical customer browses a storefront, manages a cart, and checks out; administrators manage content, products, orders, sites, and themes. The map preserves those product areas and shared runtime services. README documents several capabilities whose internal wiring is not shown in the sampled source, so those subsystems are represented without speculative call edges.
